sheets.credit: Всесоюзное аэрогеологическое научно-производственное объединение «Аэрогеология», Министерство геологии СССР, Москва 1979. Native source notices retained.
sheets.license: Source rights remain with authors/rightsholders; no open redistribution license established. Native scans, excerpts and source-derived vectors are excluded from any repository software license. Hosting on Geokniga is not proof of an open license.
sheets.limitations: Experimental color segmentation from 178 sampled native shared-legend references, not transcribed or unique units. Candidate lists not exhaustive; hatches/text/water classification approximate. Provisional georeferencing, not field-grade. Scan printed 1979; series/catalog 1979. Native historic shared legend candidates are non-unique/not exhaustive, not newly transcribed units or ages. Manual labelled-frame/black-white graticule picks are approximate (conservative20 native-pixel pick uncertainty), assumedEPSG4284, no independent landmarks. Source-only painted coverage/historic lake extent, no modern shoreline reconstruction; fine bays/hatching/river linework remain approximate. Makanchi/Taldy-Kurgan/Frunze show only actual source-painted Kazakhstan coverage; native unpainted foreign paper is masked, not filled. Manual native water/paper traces remain approximate. Foreign-paper masks are source-color connected-component refined inside conservative native context regions; coarse regions never directly erase colored geology. Native lacustrine annotations within qualified water remain in Scan; Colors is not a complete lake-sediment interpretation.
sheets.accuracy: 8 labelled native frame controls; internal grid-fit RMS 5.81px, leave-one-out max 39.32px. Grid-fit and leave-one-out residuals are not absolute geographic accuracy. Picks are approximate; all controls are on frame, not surveyed landmarks. Datum assumption, paper/scanner distortion and interior alignment remain unverified. Provisional, not field-grade.
